description: Drop mechanics, blue chest thresholds, Gold Brick (ヒヒイロカネ) rates, and Eternity Sand (刻の流砂) formulas.

blueChest.overview: Special reward chest awarded based on individual player contribution (honors). In high-level raids, honors scale the probability of earning a Blue Chest from 0% up to 100% (guaranteed). Once a Blue Chest is obtained, the item inside is rolled independently from fixed probability tables.

pbhl.notes: 1.5% drop rate inside blue chest. Best overall farming efficiency per unit time.

akasha.notes: 1.2% drop rate inside blue chest. Features turn acceleration mechanics.

gohl.notes: 1.2% drop rate inside blue chest. Multi-element team compositions benefit from Grand Order field buff.

hostChest.description: Awarded unconditionally to the host upon raid completion.
hostChest.notes: Self-hosting PBHL daily yields ~2.0% Gold Brick chance in the host chest.

mvpChest.description: Awarded to 1st place honor contributor. In modern HL raids, does NOT contain Gold Bricks (Gold Bricks were migrated strictly to Blue Chests to combat room sniping).
